sources.finding: Describes SBA as viable for leveling despite offensive and defensive shortcomings, with altered cooldown priorities.
Recommends Assisted Highlight as a beginner aid but advises against SBA for Blood because manual defensive supplementation is required.
Publishes general Deathbringer and Sanlayn imports; does not certify these user-supplied strings or an SBA optimum.

bloodSourceReview.conclusion: Publisher guidance disagrees about current Blood SBA viability. User-provided targets remain explicitly attributed to the user; neither source is claimed as their publisher.
